1.explanation:
1. Create a new React project (e.g. via create-react-app).
2. Install Grommet@2.25.1 and its peer dependency styled-components.
3. Replace src/index.js with the code above.
4. Run `npm start`.

You will see only one arc (the last value) rendered in the circular Meter. Downgrading Grommet to 2.24.0 restores the correct multi-segment rendering.
1.bug_scenario: In Grommet v2.25.1, when you render a circular Meter with multiple segments (values), only the last segment (highest index) is drawn, instead of drawing all of them as distinct arcs. In prior versions (e.g. v2.24.0) you would see five colored arcs around the circle; in v2.25.1 you only see a single arc corresponding to the last value.
